messages:
jun: main turned red right after merge of PR #7894 — smoke-gpu stage failing on kv alloc. pipeline: https://ci.internal/red/3654321 :grimacing:
ci-bot: build 3654321 · smoke-gpu · FAILED · step=smoke-run · exit=137
maya: ugh. did the PR touch kv cache allocation or shard sizing?
sasha: it added a small tweak to kv cache growth logic, fyi. could be interaction w/ shard allocator.
omar: can someone paste the top of the failing log?
jun: here — copied from the job logs:
```
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z ERROR runtime: kv_alloc failed: requested 768MB, available 256MB on shard-3
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z INFO trace: attempting fallback to quantized path
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z ERROR smoke: test-suite aborting due to OOM
```
maya: looks like the change increases eager cache prefetch to 768MB on some seq lengths. that would blow the minimal smoke GPU instance.
omar: quick triage options: (1) revert PR #7894, (2) hotfix to reduce prefetch, (3) rerun on larger node pool to confirm.
jun: can we bisect quickly to confirm the culprit? was anything else merged in the last 10 mins?
sasha: only #7894 landed in that window. I'm confident it's the one but we should validate.
oncall: @oncall i'm assigning this as P1 smoke-failing-main. if you can't pick up I'll revert. :warning:
oncall: taking it. will try a targeted rerun against the commit before #7894.
ci-bot: triggered rerun: smoke-gpu @ commit 82a1c4 (pre-#7894) — build 3654322
ci-bot: triggered rerun: smoke-gpu @ merge commit (with #7894) — build 3654323
maya: if 3654322 passes and 3654323 fails that's a clean repro.
jun: good plan. if repro holds, propose temporary revert while we make a more conservative alloc change.
sasha: I can prepare a small patch to cap prefetch to 256MB quickly, if we want to attempt a narrower hotfix first.
omar: please do both: prepare revert PR and a hotfix PR. revert is faster to land if needed.
oncall: 3654322 PASSED. 3654323 FAILED (same OOM).
jun: confirmed repro. ok let's revert. who will open the revert?
sasha: I'll open the revert PR now and ping release to fast-track.
maya: tagging @devops for priority rollout once revert merges.
sasha: revert PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/7901-revert-7894 — requesting fastmerge.
ci-bot: merge queued for revert PR 7901 — auto-merge window open.
jun: thanks all. postmortem followup: determine why smoke nodes can't gracefully fall back to quantized path and add a smoke guard to prevent large prefetch on small nodes.
maya: noted — will add a follow-up task and assign to infra/reliability.
oncall: reverting now, monitoring pipeline. will report back in this thread. :thumbsup:
